remarks: This stunning, spacious 1-bedroom condo offers the perfect balance of style, comfort, and convenience, with EVERYTHING NEW and ready for you to move right in. Step inside and discover a brand new kitchen featuring ALL NEW APPLIANCES, quartz counters, sleek finishes, and modern design. The new bathrooms, one full with shower stall and one powder room, have been tastefully updated. The entire unit boasts new floors and has been fully repainted, creating a fresh and inviting atmosphere throughout. Plus NEW WASHER and DRYER in unit. Located in the vibrant heart of Stamford, this home is surrounded by a wealth of amenities to enhance your lifestyle. Nearby, you'll find Scalzi Park, a golf course, health club, medical facilities, restaurants, shopping, tennis courts, and even Bocci courts. Plus easy access to public transportation for effortless commuting. Whether you're looking for leisure, fitness, or convenience, everything you need is just minutes away. This is a pristine one bedroom apartment, walkable to many places downtown. Don't wait, it won't last long.
